scope: Cell-by-cell audit of effective Table 87, using the printed table and its EC3 annotations, current code and assertion bodies. This is not a whole-§8.9 certificate.

primary_source.effective_table: Table 87 — Additional entries specific to an image dictionary
primary_source.general: §8.9.5.1 explicitly requires an error when an attempted base image has inconsistent dictionary entries; other producer shall restrictions are not automatically reader-error duties. Generic stream entries are Table 5; dimensions map image grid to unit square.

errata.effect: Table 87 marked keys receive additional restrictions when used by soft-mask images, cross-referring §11.6.5.2/Table 143. Treat as cross-reference, not new stand-alone image error rule.
Annotation emphasizes /Mask in the ImageMask row; no changed substantive requirement located.

Effective Table87: image masks ignore forbidden /Mask and /ColorSpace; for the /SMask row, when /SMaskInData is nonzero an explicit /SMask shall be ignored; the updated priority text is reflected in §11.6.4.3. Related SMaskInData note retains interaction cross-reference.

ledger_mapping.8.9.5: aggregate parent of image rendering; not table-cell certification
ledger_mapping.8.9.5.1: Table 87 dictionary semantics, implemented; references dispatch, cache, space, JPX, mask, unpack and image path
ledger_mapping.14.13.7: associated files on XObjects; Table 409a MCAF separate from Table87

cells.default_or_condition: No special default. Producer must name XObject when stated; no separate reader rule requires rejection for a wrong optional marker.
cells.indirectness: No Table87-specific indirect prohibition; generic §7.3.10 applies.
cells.implementation_and_assertions: No dedicated reader assertion found; stream dispatch is by /Subtype and stream context.
cells.verdict: Not treated as a draw-time conformance gap: optional marker and no explicit reader rejection contract identified.

cells.effective_rule: name; required for ordinary image XObjects; optional only when used solely as a thumbnail; value /Image
cells.default_or_condition: The conditional thumbnail exception is explicit; wrong type/name is malformed producer data, not automatically a mandatory reader refusal absent a reader-directed rule.
cells.implementation_and_assertions: Ordinary XObject dispatch in content/xobject.rs; thumbnail parsing has its own module. Existing image fixtures provide /Subtype /Image; no focused missing-subtype behavior assertion found.
cells.verdict: Implementation consumers assume image route; sampled render tests are valid-image cases. No new negative test drafted because reader rejection policy is not established.

cells.default_or_condition: No default; dimensions jointly determine sample grid and unit-square placement; resource limits are implementation/reporting boundaries.
cells.indirectness: Indirect values generally permitted by §7.3.10; dimension() resolves.
cells.verdict: Strong valid and malformed cases; no missing per-cell behavior identified.

cells.indirectness: Indirect values generally permitted by §7.3.10; dimension() resolves.
cells.implementation_and_assertions: Same named dimensions tests; image_coordinates_audit.rs verifies placement / orientation.
cells.verdict: Strong selected coverage, not all codec dimensions.

cells.effective_rule: name/array; required except JPXDecode; prohibited on image masks; any colour-space family except Pattern. For JPX, stated PDF space overrides embedded color declaration; absent uses codestream.
cells.default_or_condition: For JPX with absent /ColorSpace, /Decode is ignored unless /ImageMask true. Under EC3 #215, forbidden /ColorSpace beside /ImageMask true is ignored.
cells.indirectness: No Table87 directness restriction; named colour-space resources and indirect objects are resolved by colour_space().
cells.implementation_and_assertions: image_masks.rs::image_mask... cases and image_masking_audit.rs::ec3_image_mask_ignores_its_own_mask_and_colour_space_entries; jpx_enumerated_spaces.rs controls; jpx_channels.rs::four_channels_under_a_declared_cmyk_space_are_all_colour; colour_paths.rs consumer assertions.
cells.verdict: Substantive JPX precedence, mask exception, device/ICC/Indexed branches are distributed across dedicated shards. No duplicate test draft.

cells.effective_rule: integer, required except masks and JPX; allowed 1,2,4,8,16 (16 from PDF1.5); one value shared across components; mask if present exactly 1; for filtered input consistent with sample output (Fax/JBIG2 one-bit; RunLength/DCT eight-bit; LZW/Flate predictor-dependent). JPX value ignored if present.
cells.default_or_condition: No default generally; image-mask omission is interpreted as 1. EC3 #215 does not excuse a wrong BPC on image masks.
cells.verdict: Wide coverage from sample decode and filter-specific siblings; do not infer every filter/profile combination.

cells.effective_rule: name, optional; rendering intent for non-mask image; ignored for image mask
cells.default_or_condition: Defaults to graphics-state intent; mask use ignored.
cells.implementation_and_assertions: rendering_intent.rs::an_images_own_intent_selects_the_transform_its_samples_take, ::an_image_without_an_intent_takes_the_graphics_states, ::an_unrecognised_intent_name_is_relative_colorimetric; image-mask branch tested by relevant rendering intent tests.
cells.verdict: Strong route-specific transform pixels; synthetic profiles are not full ICC certification.

cells.effective_rule: boolean, optional; default false; true means stencil; no ColorSpace or Mask; BPC absent or 1; Decode [0 1] or [1 0]; unmarked areas use current nonstroking color.
cells.default_or_condition: EC3 #215 explicitly says forbidden /ColorSpace and /Mask values are ignored when true. Intent is ignored. #14 is emphasis on the Mask term, no semantic change.
cells.implementation_and_assertions: image_masks.rs stencil decode, current-fill, pattern, soft mask, interpolation tests; image_masking_audit.rs::ec3_image_mask_ignores_its_own_mask_and_colour_space_entries and ::an_image_mask_with_more_than_one_bit_per_component_reports_inconsistency.
cells.verdict: Good selected consumer tests across stencil/mask behaviors. Do not require refusal for #215-ignore cases.

cells.effective_rule: stream or array; optional; image mask stream or color-key ranges; forbidden on stencil.
cells.default_or_condition: Overridden by image /SMask or nonzero /SMaskInData; EC3 #215 says a simultaneous explicit /SMask is ignored with nonzero SMaskInData. No default other than absent.
cells.indirectness: Stream object/array and nested references may be indirect under generic rules; parser resolves.
cells.implementation_and_assertions: image_masks.rs::an_explicit_mask_paints_the_base_image_only_where_it_marks, ::colour_key_masking_removes_the_samples_inside_the_range, ::the_colour_key_bounds_are_inclusive, codec-specific color-key tests; stencil-ignore in image_masking_audit.
cells.verdict: Broad separate mask shard covers both forms/codecs. Producer conflict not converted into refusal.

cells.effective_rule: array of numeric pairs; optional; length is twice color component count, or for mask exact [0 1] or [1 0]; defaults in Table88 by color space. JPX with no ColorSpace ignores unless stencil.
cells.default_or_condition: JPX no-CS exception; EC3 #215 does not cancel Decode condition. Base image entries inconsistent with each other shall cause error (§8.9.5.1). B11 is a current confirmed failure, not a pending candidate.
cells.indirectness: Array and items may be indirect by generic §7.3.10; values resolved.
cells.implementation_and_assertions: decode_arrays.rs and image_samples_decode_audit.rs literal values; jpx_decode_array.rs tests stated-space applied/no-space ignored; image_dictionary_consistency_audit.rs short/long pair errors and valid control. Existing image shard has a draft for correctly-sized array with nonnumeric member; not duplicated here. Confirmed expected failure B11: decode_element_types_audit.rs::decode_pairs_must_each_be_numbers (waves6/8).
cells.verdict: Confirmed bounded failure 2038-B11: `pdf-model::decode_element_types_audit::decode_pairs_must_each_be_numbers` fails because a correctly sized Decode array with a non-number member is filtered/shifted. Pair-count controls in image_dictionary_consistency_audit remain valid; no duplicate test draft is needed.

cells.effective_rule: boolean optional; default false; whether processor should interpolate.
cells.default_or_condition: Hint for magnified/low-resolution image; reader may ignore; does not require a fixed kernel or reduction policy. Soft-mask restrictions appear separately Table143/#13.
cells.verdict: Tests pin implementation choice, not a mandatory exact interpolation algorithm.

cells.effective_rule: array optional; PDF1.3; not permitted on an alternate image itself.
cells.default_or_condition: Selection algorithm is effective EC3 #79, not 2020 four-step text; conditions depend on visibility, printing, DefaultForPrinting and array order.
cells.indirectness: Array entries / dictionaries may be indirect.
cells.implementation_and_assertions: optional_content.rs and alternate_images_audit.rs::print_without_designated_or_visible_alternate_falls_back_to_base; ::the_first_of_two_visible_alternates_wins_in_array_order; optional-content selected-image OC test.
cells.verdict: Strong selected algorithm, not full alternate malformed-field validation.

cells.effective_rule: stream optional; subsidiary soft-mask image used as shape or opacity by AIS. Overrides GS soft mask and /Mask; other blend mode and alpha constants remain. If absent and SMaskInData=0, no associated mask except current GS mask.
cells.default_or_condition: EC3 #215: if nonzero SMaskInData and SMask is present, SMask shall be ignored. Issue #13 links additional restrictions to Table143; #215 also revises the priority text.
cells.indirectness: Indirect stream reference (mandatory stream value implies indirect object).
cells.implementation_and_assertions: soft_masks.rs::none_removes_the_mask; image_masks.rs::a_soft_mask_overrides_an_explicit_mask; soft_mask_dictionary_audit knockout; jpx_ordinary_opacity_audit code2/SMask conflict not valid producer combination, and code path explicitly skips separate mask when opacity came with samples.
cells.verdict: Current code follows nonzero in-data precedence in soft_masked; ordinary JPX alpha tests code0/1/2. No valid combination missing.

cells.effective_rule: integer optional for JPX only, meaningless otherwise; default 0. 0 ignores embedded alpha; 1 creates a soft mask from opacity channel; 2 says colors premultiplied and opacity included, requiring unpremultiplication plus mask. Nonzero requires exactly one shared opacity channel and conflicts with /SMask.
cells.default_or_condition: EC3 #215 states explicit /SMask ignored if present with nonzero; NOTE interactions remain §11.6.4.3. Table87 and §7.4.9 each constrain nonzero opacity channel. Code2 remains a valid producer combination and fails in the pinned JPX decoder; do not describe code2 as reconstructed/passing.
cells.verdict: B14 confirms a valid code-2 JP2 cdef opacity input is refused before rasterization because the pinned decoder treats the premultiplied opacity channel as a fourth color component; code0 and code1 positive controls pass. This is specific to the sampled codec/cdef route.

cells.effective_rule: name; required PDF1.0, optional otherwise, deprecated PDF2.0
cells.default_or_condition: Image stream is referenced by resource-dictionary name at the use site; the entry itself is not current routing authority. EC3 #619 marks deprecated PDF2.0.
cells.implementation_and_assertions: XObject dispatcher uses `Do` resource key and image stream; no image stream /Name consumer found.
cells.verdict: No mandatory rendering difference established. No test draft.

cells.effective_rule: integer required if image is a structural content item; key to parent tree.
cells.default_or_condition: Condition is “if image is a structural content item”; not every image must carry it.
cells.indirectness: Indirect integer permitted per general dictionary value rule.
cells.implementation_and_assertions: structure::owners.rs object-to-element lookup reads StructParent generically; existing object/annotation/form paths tested; image-specific actual content consumer was not found in inspected image tests.
cells.verdict: Behavior owned by structure subsystem; no duplicate test. Need avoid interpreting conditional producer entry as every image reader failure.

cells.effective_rule: byte string optional, PDF1.3, indirect preferred; Web Capture parent-set identifier
cells.default_or_condition: No default; not page-image identity for ordinary renderer.
cells.indirectness: May be direct; indirect preferred explicitly, not required.
cells.implementation_and_assertions: No image dictionary ID consumer found in image rendering path; Web Capture is a separate feature boundary.

cells.effective_rule: dictionary optional PDF1.2, deprecated PDF2.0; ignored if ImageMask=true
cells.default_or_condition: PDF2 deprecation; OPI is prepress metadata.
cells.implementation_and_assertions: No OPI consumer in sampled image path.
cells.verdict: No current rendering behavior claim or new test.

cells.effective_rule: stream optional PDF1.4, metadata stream for image
cells.default_or_condition: No Table87 default. Metadata packet semantics are §14.3.2.
cells.indirectness: Stream indirect per stream object requirement.
cells.implementation_and_assertions: XMP generic reader handles catalog/page/component dictionaries; image metadata consumer not found in this selected path. Attachment/meta shards own remaining API behavior.
cells.verdict: No claim viewer must show image-specific metadata absent an API/UI contract.

limits: Image metadata/OPI/Web Capture optional fields are representation or specialized-consumer areas; not ordinary painted-pixel obligations.
Table87 entries cross-reference filter, color-space, structure and transparency subclauses. This mapping samples their Table87-facing condition only; no codec or color-family certification.
No malformed-input rejection is inferred merely from producer constraints except where §8.9.5.1 or another explicit reader-directed statement applies.

B11 (numeric members of /Decode) and B14 (JPX cdef premultiplied opacity) are confirmed failures in global findings.json and expected-failures.json; this matrix records them as such and adds no duplicate draft.

adjacent_extensions.source: The XObject stream dictionary shall contain an AF array of file specification dictionaries; relationship is supplied by each FileSpec AFRelationship. This is a writer-side association rule; §6.3.2.2 does not make rendering processors consumers of the file payload.
adjacent_extensions.ledger: §14.13.7 implemented; §8.9.5.1 image AF note points to this sibling consumer.
adjacent_extensions.consumer_and_assertion: crates/pdf-model/src/attachment.rs::associated_under; crates/pdf-model/src/attachment.rs test `an_images_associated_file_reads_back_through_the_general_reader` reads the image stream dictionary AF through the same general associated-file reader.
adjacent_extensions.verdict: Image AF recognition/API coverage exists; no image rendering duty inferred. Distinct from marked-content MCAF and not part of Table 87.
